THE APPROACH

Four rules that survive contact with production
01
Deterministic before clever

A gate that cannot be reproduced is not a gate. The analysis core answers the same way for the same inputs, and the policy that decides the outcome is a file in the repository — reviewable, versioned, diffable.

dependency-risk-radar: same refs + same policy = same decision · Forgix: --dry-run preview and a lock file per scaffold.

02
Local-first, explicit trust boundaries

Data stays where it was created unless exporting is the point. Where a tool has to touch the machine, the boundary is stated and enforced rather than implied.

CindR: IndexedDB, no accounts, no cloud sync · Forgix: 0600 config, path traversal blocked, sensitive directories refused · modelguard: format handlers that inspect artefacts without executing them.

03
Limits belong in the README

Every one of these projects publishes what it does not do — JavaScript-only v1 ecosystems, an alpha signature registry, a tracker that will not cancel your subscriptions. The honest version is more useful than the impressive one.

dependency-risk-radar: pre-1.0, no multi-workspace discovery · modelguard: curated signatures, absence is not proof of safety · CindR: no bank linking, no auto-cancellation.

04
Motion is optional, accessibility is not

This page animates with GSAP, Lenis smooth scroll and canvas treatments — and it will hold completely still if you or your operating system ask it to. Every canvas is decorative, every control is keyboard reachable, and every detail panel is a labelled dialog.

Use the Motion control in the header: one click replaces animation with stills and restores native scrolling.

THE APPROACH

Four rules that survive contact with production
01
Deterministic before clever

A gate that cannot be reproduced is not a gate. The analysis core answers the same way for the same inputs, and the policy that decides the outcome is a file in the repository — reviewable, versioned, diffable.

dependency-risk-radar: same refs + same policy = same decision · Forgix: --dry-run preview and a lock file per scaffold.

02
Local-first, explicit trust boundaries

Data stays where it was created unless exporting is the point. Where a tool has to touch the machine, the boundary is stated and enforced rather than implied.

CindR: IndexedDB, no accounts, no cloud sync · Forgix: 0600 config, path traversal blocked, sensitive directories refused · modelguard: format handlers that inspect artefacts without executing them.

03
Limits belong in the README

Every one of these projects publishes what it does not do — JavaScript-only v1 ecosystems, an alpha signature registry, a tracker that will not cancel your subscriptions. The honest version is more useful than the impressive one.

dependency-risk-radar: pre-1.0, no multi-workspace discovery · modelguard: curated signatures, absence is not proof of safety · CindR: no bank linking, no auto-cancellation.

04
Motion is optional, accessibility is not

This page animates with GSAP, Lenis smooth scroll and canvas treatments — and it will hold completely still if you or your operating system ask it to. Every canvas is decorative, every control is keyboard reachable, and every detail panel is a labelled dialog.

Use the Motion control in the header: one click replaces animation with stills and restores native scrolling.
